new_operators.diagnostic: If removing either series still leaves the joke, FAIL. Pass = equivocation with both readings live plus a breakup-or-patch moment.
new_operators.instruction: Build two independent causal series (A: the character's plan, B: another plan or the past intruding). Make them coincide for one scene so the same words and actions read correctly in both while each character sees only one.

new_operators.diagnostic: If steps can be reordered or removed without breaking the chain, FAIL. Pass = unbroken traceable chain plus felt acceleration.
new_operators.instruction: Start from a trivial cause, roll up 3-5 necessary consequences each larger than the last; end with circular return to the start or a disproportionate result. Preserve strict cause-effect linkage.

note: Mined 2026-10-08 from comedy/theory shelf (Bergson, Freud). Shape mirrors figgsite operators + v2 REGISTRY: {id, family, instruction, diagnostic}. Staged for merge into figgsite backend/creative/operators.py and v2 operators.py — do not renumber existing operators.

refinements.diagnostic: If repetition is verbatim copy, FAIL — needs mathematical order plus likelihood. Pass = third occurrence triggers recognition then expectation break. Constant forces recombining = character-driven; mesmerized audience = contrived.
refinements.instruction: Repeat the same situation 3 times across 3 tempi with variation: same characters in fresh circumstances, masters then servants in a lower key, or ever-fresh surroundings. Repeat the combination, never the words.

refinements.diagnostic: If inverted version no longer makes sense, FAIL. Pass = serves-you-right resonance, even as a single-word allusion.
refinements.instruction: Reverse roles or situation so the trap recoils on the trapper: lecturer becomes lectured, subject and object swap. Either half may be shown if the other is in mind.

refinements.diagnostic: If no natural expression is recoverable by the audience, FAIL. Pass = audience spontaneously supplies the natural key and sees the rigidity.
refinements.instruction: Transpose an everyday idea into solemn professional jargon, or the solemn into familiar parody; or show a professional seeing only through trade formulas. Prolong systematically.

refinements.diagnostic: The uncondensed paraphrase must lose the point while saving syllables. If plain wording works as well, FAIL.
refinements.instruction: Fuse two ideas into one composite word or phrase. The compression itself is the joke.

refinements.diagnostic: Both readings must be live in context. If the kinship of senses is mere sound short-circuit, FAIL.
refinements.instruction: Use the same material twice: whole and part, name and thing, metaphorical and literal, pun proper. Require real kinship of senses.

refinements.diagnostic: Undo the displacement: if the joke survives, it was not displacement. Pass = sideways answer whose direct version is flat.
refinements.instruction: Answer sideways: shift accent or topic so the reply lands beside the question. The indirection itself carries the payload.

refinements.diagnostic: Reduction must yield the indignant opposite. If the opposite is merely mild, FAIL.
refinements.instruction: Replace a required no with yes-but, praise ugliness via the Venus of Milo, boast cleanliness to convict uncleanliness. Includes irony.

refinements.diagnostic: Attack and defense must share a single frame. If the counterattack needs a new topic, FAIL.
refinements.instruction: Establish unexpected unity between attack and counterattack: tu quoque paid back in the same coin, X-and-Y coordination.

refinements.diagnostic: Expose the logic: if no tendentious moral remains, it was decoration, not facade. Pass = flaw survivable only while the facade distracts.
refinements.instruction: Build sophistical logic with a comic or logical facade masking the flaw. The flaw must be load-bearing once seen.

refinements.diagnostic: The direct statement would be flat or offensive. If direct works as well, FAIL.
refinements.instruction: Let nonsense replace ridicule or criticism; use allusion or citation as shortcut instead of direct statement. Indirection bribes the audience's criticism.
